studyPlan.activities: Synonyms, antonyms, idioms, one-word substitutions, spelling and grammar foundations
Number system, percentages, ratio, HCF/LCM, simplification and averages
Constitution, Indian history, UP geography and general science
Number series, coding, analogy, odd-one-out, direction and blood relations
Time and work, speed and distance, simple interest, profit/loss and data handling
Economy, UP administration, environment, science revision, current affairs from verified sources
Take original 150-question mock A; review errors and revise weaker topics
Take original 150-question mocks B and C, revise notes, practice OMR marking and review official notices

recruitment2025.educationalQualification: Intermediate / Class 12 or equivalent from a legally established or government-recognised board; appearing candidates were ineligible under the 2025 notice
recruitment2025.note: These ages include the one-time three-year 05-01-2026 relaxation for recruitment 2025, plus five years for eligible SC/ST/OBC applicants. Age boundaries and extra rules differ for other groups and future recruitments.
recruitment2025.payMatrix: Level 3, ₹21,700–₹69,100 per month (basic pay matrix; allowances separate)
